title: Stirling Engine
description: The &3Stirling Engine&r uses heat from a &3Heating Oven&r or a &3&r&3Firebox&r to produce power. If a Heating Oven is used to heat a Stirling engine, it will likely over-speed and damage it, sending the main gear flying. The heavy Stirling engine does not have this issue.
A firebox running on coal with a stirling engine produces &e2kHE/s&r, while a heating oven with a heavy stirling engine produces &e10kHE/s&r.
